interps.court: Supreme Court of the United States
interps.summary: A child's habitual residence under Article 3 of the Hague Convention depends on the totality of the circumstances; an actual agreement between the parents is not required. (Non-official summary — FIXTURE.)
excerpts: We hold that a child's habitual residence depends on the totality of the circumstances specific to the case.
